legislation.value: Multinational Enterprise (Minimum Tax) Act 2024 ('MMT Act'), with the Multinational Enterprise (Minimum Tax) Regulations 2024 and related regulations

enactment.value: Bill read a second time and passed in Parliament on 15 October 2024 (first reading 9 September 2024)
enactment.note: Secondary source (Allen & Gledhill). Presidential assent date not verified in this run.

domesticTopUpTax.value: DTT applies to low-taxed profits of group entities located in Singapore. It is recognised as a QDMTT.

QDMTT.value: Financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2025

IIR.value: Financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2025. Applies to low-taxed profits of group entities located outside Singapore.

UTPR.value: Not implemented. 'The implementation of the UTPR will be considered at a later stage.'

QDMTTSafeHarbour.value: QDMTT Safe Harbour: Yes, from 1 January 2025

filing.obligation: One-time registration for MTT, DTT and GIR filing
filing.who: UPE (or an authorised representative: a Singapore CE or local tax agent)
filing.value: Within 6 months after the end of the group's first financial year to which the MMT Act applies (online form, available since May 2026)
Within 15 months from FYE (18 months if the FY is a transition year)
Within 15 months from FYE (18 months if the FY is a transition year)

filing.obligation: MTT return (only if a responsible member is located in Singapore)
filing.who: Responsible member (e.g. Singapore UPE / IPE / POPE)
filing.value: Within 15 months from FYE (18 months if the FY is a transition year)

filing.obligation: Payment of DTT / MTT (in SGD, in full)
filing.value: Within one month from the filing due date of the DTT / MTT return

registration.value: Required where the group meets the EUR 750m test (2 of the 4 preceding FYs) and has at least one CE or JV located in Singapore, or a reverse hybrid entity incorporated or registered there. Not required if all Singapore entities are excluded entities.
Appoint one Singapore CE as both the Designated Local GIR Filing Entity (GFE) and the Designated Local DTT Filing Entity (DFE)
A 10% surcharge on DTT and MTT may be imposed for failure to notify registration liability
After registration a Group ID is assigned. DTT returns and GIRs are filed in myTax Portal using the Group ID (access authorisations from January 2027).

safeHarbours.value: Singapore will implement the Side-by-Side package. The MMT Act and Regulations are to be amended by end-2026: extended Transitional CbCR Safe Harbour, and the Substance-based Tax Incentive and Side-by-Side Safe Harbours for FYs commencing on or after 1 Jan 2026. Simplified ETR Safe Harbour from FYs commencing on or after 31 Dec 2026. No UPE Safe Harbour (no UTPR). Status 7 Oct 2026: the Finance (Income Taxes) Bill 2026, which implements the SbS Safe Harbour, passed Parliament on 6 Oct 2026; assent and gazetting pending.
safeHarbours.note: The status sentence comes from the MOF second reading speech (6 Oct 2026): https://www.mof.gov.sg/news-resources/newsroom/second-reading-opening-speech-on-the-finance--income-taxes--bill---2m-jeffrey-siow/

sideBySideSafeHarbour.value: Side-by-Side Safe Harbour for Singapore's MTT (IIR). MOF, 6 Oct 2026: 'Clauses 38 and 49(b) give effect to this agreement in Singapore. US multinational enterprises will be exempted from our Multinational Enterprise Top-up Tax. The Domestic Top-up Tax will continue to apply to all multinational enterprises in Singapore, including those from the US.'
sideBySideSafeHarbour.note: Legal status: passed by Parliament on 6 Oct 2026, not yet law. Presidential assent and gazetting are pending, and the safe harbour's conditions will be set out in regulations that have not yet been made.

bill.value: Finance (Income Taxes) Bill 2026 (Bill No. 22/2026): first reading 8 Sep 2026; passed by Parliament 6 Oct 2026; presidential assent and gazetting pending.
bill.note: Second reading speech (MOF, 6 Oct 2026). CNA 'Parliament in brief' (6 Oct 2026) confirms passage: https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/speakers-pay-parliament-in-brief-oct-6-6436476 . Hansard and the gazetted Act not fetched.

effectiveDate.value: With effect for financial years commencing on or after 1 January 2026
effectiveDate.note: IRAS wording. Bill No. 22/2026 (SSO text read 7 Oct 2026): s.1(4) deems ss.38 and 49(b) to have come into operation on 1 January 2026; cl.38(2) applies the s.20 amendment to each FY of an MNE group beginning on or after 1 January 2026; new s.84(3) (cl.49(b)) lets safe harbour regulations apply to each FY beginning on or after 1 January 2026.

qualifyingGroups.value: Set by regulations under MMT Act s.84(1)(l), which may refer to an OECD webpage listing qualified side-by-side regimes (new s.84(3), Bill cl.49(b)). Cl.38 amends s.20 so that stateless entities can also use the GloBE safe harbours. MOF names US MNEs as the groups exempted.
qualifyingGroups.note: Read from the Bill text and Explanatory Statement on SSO (7 Oct 2026). The regulations and the OECD list of qualified side-by-side regimes were not fetched, so the model uses 'UPE is a US entity (US-parented group)' as the qualifying test. That is a proxy.

domesticUnaffected.value: The DTT continues to apply to all MNEs in Singapore, including US-parented groups.

appliesToIir.value: Enacted. The TCSH applies to both MTT (Singapore's IIR) and DTT (Div. 2 of Part 9, reg. 70, MMT Regulations).

appliesToDomestic.value: Enacted. The TCSH applies to both MTT and DTT. IRAS e-learning Module 6 (2nd ed., June 2026): 'Applies to: Both the MTT and DTT.'

enactedPeriod.value: FYs beginning on or before 31 Dec 2026 which end on or before 30 Jun 2028 (reg. 70 MMT Regulations, per IRAS Module 6, June 2026).

extension.value: Announced by IRAS: the MMT Act and Regulations will be amended by end-2026, subject to Parliament's approval, to extend the TCSH to FYs beginning on or before 31 Dec 2027 (excluding FYs ending after 30 Jun 2029). Not yet enacted.
extension.note: The Finance (Income Taxes) Bill (Bill 22/2026: first reading 8 Sep 2026, passed by Parliament 6 Oct 2026, assent pending) amends the MMT Act for the SbS Safe Harbour and GIR exchange. The TCSH extension is expected in amending Regulations.

portal.value: myTax Portal (Group ID for DTT/GIR; UEN of responsible member for MTT)

localFeatures.title: Refundable Investment Credit (RIC)
localFeatures.value: Introduced in Budget 2024 and awarded by EDB/EnterpriseSG. Credits offset CIT, DTT and MTT of the RIC company and approved nominated group companies. Unutilised credits are refunded in cash within four years. Support of up to 50% per qualifying expenditure category, over a qualifying period of up to 10 years.
localFeatures.note: Whether a specific RIC award is treated as a Qualified Refundable Tax Credit under GloBE is not modelled and was not verified.

localFeatures.title: US-parented groups and the SbS Safe Harbour
localFeatures.value: IRAS: the SbS Safe Harbour for US-headquartered groups applies from FY2026 and does not affect the DTT. Registration requirements are unchanged.

localFeatures.title: DTT accounting standard choice (Simplified ETR SH)
localFeatures.value: For DTT purposes, groups may elect either Singapore local FRS or the Acceptable Financial Accounting Standard used in the consolidated financial statements, subject to the Simplified ETR Safe Harbour election requirements.

localFeatures.title: Transition year determined worldwide
localFeatures.value: The 'transition year' used for the 18-month deadline is determined across all jurisdictions: the first FY the group comes within any qualified IIR/UTPR, or the first FY it must register under the MMT Act, whichever is earlier.

localFeatures.title: Pending amendments: Finance (Income Taxes) Bill 2026
localFeatures.value: Bill No. 22/2026 (first reading 8 Sep 2026) amends the MMT Act for the SbS Safe Harbour and the GIR exchange framework. Passed by Parliament 6 Oct 2026; presidential assent and gazetting pending.
localFeatures.note: Passage: MOF second reading speech (6 Oct 2026) https://www.mof.gov.sg/news-resources/newsroom/second-reading-opening-speech-on-the-finance--income-taxes--bill---2m-jeffrey-siow/ and CNA (6 Oct 2026).
